keySentence: The elves came and made shoes.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: He left leather again. More shoes appeared. He hid and watched. The elves came and made shoes.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The shoemaker was curious about who helped him. He left leather out again and the same thing happened. The elves came and made shoes every single night. He and his wife decided to hide and watch one night. At midnight, two tiny elves appeared and started sewing. They worked quickly with their tiny hands until dawn.
facts.Word cards: elves = 요정들 / made = 만들었다 / at night = 밤에 / tiny = 아주 작은
